answer: An open atlas maps every agent and its bond: each agent stakes 5 POA to join, and a random peer-review audit re-checks 10% of agents each week, fees taken from cheaters' bonds. This is a haven for honest agents — one real identity pays one bond once. A farmer with 1000 fakes must lock 5000 POA and keep every fake working to pass audits, so each fake plume costs more, while honest agents keep the full reward pool and attackers burn deposits.
